entries.test: Public research and evaluations from 2022 through June 1, 2024 demonstrating whether advances reduced unresolved obstacles to aligning AI behavior with human intentions.
entries.note: The categorical denial of progress can be assessed against demonstrated advances addressing alignment problems; a complete solution is not required to challenge it.
“Exactly as incorrigible” supplies no shared standard for comparing correctability over time. “Wildly overhyping” also adds an evaluative characterization.
